messages:
maria-ml: heads up — eval CI for the new q8 build shows embedding cosine shift on onboarding prompts, avg delta ~ -0.07 vs baseline. canary threshold exceeded :frowning:
cheng-infra: ack. which commit/runner? link?
eval-ci-bot: CI job: https://ci.redwood.dev/17902 (build: 2026-03-18T09:22Z)
	eval summary: model=llama-2-7b, profile=q8-release, metric=embed_cos_sim, baseline=0.882 -> canary=0.812, p99 latency unchanged
sam-runner: did we change any tokenization/normalization or kv-prefetch behavior in the runner lately?
maria-ml: not on our side. last change was cheng's tokenizer bump in infra libs (tokenizers 0.12.4 -> 0.13.0) and a small kv prefetch tweak in runner to avoid double-writes.
cheng-infra: oh yeah that tokenizer bump landed in staging yesterday in the infra image tag `infra:v2026-03-17-9a1b`
olivia-product: impact on feature gating? is this visible to users beyond eval sets?
maria-ml: preliminary sampling of prod traffic (few requests) shows tokenization only differs on some unicode normalization cases — can change embedding alignment. might be why embed_cos_sim dropped.
ryan-sre: we should bisect quickly. can someone run `git bisect` between infra tags?
sam-runner: I'll spin a local bisect against the eval harness runner container and run a small eval job. will report back in ~30m.

sam-runner: running bisect...
```
git bisect start infra:v2026-03-17-9a1b infra:v2026-03-15-6f4c
# run eval harness script against commit
```

sam-runner: bisect points to commit `upgrade-tokenizers-0.13` (sha abc123) — tokenizer change correlates with drop.
cheng-infra: that commit changed normalization (NFKC -> NFD) to address emoji segmentation. oops.
maria-ml: that explains it. NFKC vs NFD will alter codepoint sequences and embedding inputs.
olivia-product: recommendation? rollback the tokenizer change from the infra image in canary?
ryan-sre: agree — pause quant canary rollout. revert infra tag for canary clusters to `infra:v2026-03-15-6f4c` and re-run smoke evals. I'll schedule rollback.
maria-ml: creating follow-up eval ticket with failing prompt examples and minimal repro. linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-1423
cheng-infra: I'll open a patch PR to restore NFKC behavior for model-serving image and add explicit normalization toggle behind a feature flag.
sam-runner: after rollback smoke pass, we should re-run full eval harness and gate on embed_cos_sim >= baseline - 0.02 before unblocking release.
olivia-product: noted — hold release until metric gates pass. inform release management.
eval-ci-bot: scheduled post-rollback job: https://ci.redwood.dev/17905 (will run in 10m)
maria-ml: thanks y'all. good catch. I'll paste a couple of failing prompts into ML-1423 for regression tests.
cheng-infra: also adding a unit test for tokenizer normalization and an integration test in infra image pipeline.
ryan-sre: rollback in progress on canary at 2026-03-18T10:05Z — monitoring. :eyes:
maria-ml: :thumbsup:
